verdict.rationale: Grok Build has its own programmatic surfaces: a headless mode for scripts and bots with plain, JSON or streaming-JSON output, and an ACP agent interface over JSON-RPC on stdin/stdout. A community user also praised the headless mode and full ACP support. Nothing documents that these surfaces match everything the TUI does, and several features are described only as TUI features (the dashboard, the Marketplace tab, the /resume picker). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented programmatic equivalents for TUI-only features like the dashboard, marketplace and session picker, and an API reference for the ACP surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: This runs Grok as an ACP agent over JSON-RPC on stdin/stdout.
Use headless mode for scripts, bots, or other machine-friendly tasks.
Use it via an interactive TUI, headlessly in scripts or bots, or through the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) in other apps
